title: Operations Cancel Action Permission Consistency

items.action: cancel an operation from the Operations page

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.operations.execute permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing cancel-operation authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; only the Operations-page cancel action is aligned with the existing execute authorization.

audit.reason: Existing operation-cancel audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The /operations route still requires its existing read permission; this change only gates the cancel mutation action.

notes: OperationsPage previously rendered and invoked the cancel row action based only on operation state, while the backend requires fair_crm.operations.execute. The cancel entry point now hides and fails closed without execute permission.
